title: Facilitating Bug Detection for OpenMP Offloading Applications
problem: OpenMP offloading applications suffer from data inconsistencies when moving data between CPU and GPU. The predecessor tool ARBALEST has inaccurate data movement modeling and insufficient debugging information for developers.
motivation: Detecting bugs in GPU-offloaded code is critical as heterogeneous computing with OpenMP offloading becomes more prevalent in HPC and scientific applications.
method: ARBALEST-VEC introduces a new OpenMP Tool interface (OMPT) event called device_mem to accurately capture data movements between CPU and GPU with reduced overhead. It implements shadow memory tracking and vectorized dynamic analysis using SIMD instructions for efficient detection. The tool leverages enhanced debug information from newer LLVM versions to generate detailed bug reports.
key_novelty: Introduction of the device_mem OMPT event for accurate and efficient capture of data movements in GPU offloading with significantly reduced runtime overhead.
contributions: New device_mem OMPT event for precise data movement tracking and detection
Vectorized dynamic analysis using SIMD instructions for improved detection performance
Enhanced debugging capabilities through improved LLVM debug information utilization
Lower runtime overhead and more predictable memory usage compared to ARBALEST

metrics.other: reduced runtime overhead, more predictable memory usage

primary_theme: dynamic analysis for GPU offloading bug detection
